name: algokit-localnet
description: AlgoKit LocalNet operations for status, KMD account listing, and local funding
author: APlane Shell Team

commands.name: localnet
commands.description: Inspect and fund a local AlgoKit LocalNet

functions.name: localnetStatus
functions.description: Show algod and KMD status for AlgoKit LocalNet
functions.returns: {network: string, algodUrl: string, kmdUrl: string, genesisId: string, genesisHash: string, lastRound: number}

functions.name: localnetAccounts
functions.description: List KMD accounts in the configured AlgoKit LocalNet wallet
functions.returns: {wallet: string, accounts: [{address: string, balance: number, minBalance: number, spendable: number}]}

functions.name: localnetFund
functions.description: Fund an address from a KMD account in AlgoKit LocalNet

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount with optional unit, default 100 ALGO

functions.returns: {from: string, to: string, amount: number, txid: string, confirmedRound: number}
